messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=2026.03.12.r12 to env=eu-canary (fraction=10%). Post-deploy synthetic: prefix-kv probe failing intermittently (2/10 failures) starting ~1968205428. probe: `kv-prefix-check`

sanjay: seeing the 2/10 failures — any pattern on seq length or backend?

irene: logs show timeouts to upstream redis-ish cluster around the same window. attaching excerpt:
```
[1968205428] probe=kv-prefix-check id=7 status=timeout duration=1203ms route=eu-west-2-svc-3
[1968205430] probe=kv-prefix-check id=8 status=ok duration=42ms route=eu-west-2-svc-1
[1968205432] probe=kv-prefix-check id=9 status=timeout duration=1178ms route=eu-west-2-svc-3
```

mia: could be node 3 getting hot due to warm-up + new codepath. we saw a similar pattern in r09 when prefix cache invalidation hit.

jordan: linked metrics: https://grafana.redwood/inch/synth/kv-prefix?panel=3 (rollup 1m). spike aligns with the canary start.

ops-bot: Canary health summary: success=8 fail=2 p95_latency=210ms p99_latency=1.1s error_rate=20% (on probe). Overall app traffic healthy.

sanjay: thoughts? rollback to r11 for eu-only or pin traffic away from canary?

irene: i'm leaning toward pause and pin. 10% -> 0% until we verify. failures are real timeouts, not flakiness. threshold for automatic rollback is 30% but we shouldn't wait.

mia: agree with pin. quick mitigation options: 1) reduce canary fraction to 0, 2) route eu-canary to fallback pool (previous instance churn), 3) increase probe retry to 2 attempts for short-window false positives.

jordan: ops teams — can you run a targeted kv probe against node-3 and check connections / ephemerals? `ssh ops@eu3 -- sudo netstat -tnp | grep redis`

ops-bot: Running quick check: node-3 CPU at 86% for the window, connection queue length spiked. No recent infra deploys. Possible GC or model warm-up.

sanjay: ok let's execute plan: (a) set canary fraction=0 for eu, (b) create pin to r11 for eu until root cause found, (c) open postmortem if we end up rolling back. I'll patch rollout in the console now.

irene: also logging an action to tweak probe config (increase retry count to 2, backoff 200ms) and add a one-off synthetic run across the pool. I'll file a short PR to ops-config.

mia: canary reduced to 0% (done). pin created: release=2026.03.11.r11 scoped=eu.

jordan: re-run synthetic after pin: ops-bot, start a 1-min aggressive run (20 probes) across eu nodes.

ops-bot: running synthetic batch -> results: 20/20 success, p99=95ms on pinned pool. node-3 recovered after scaling cooldown.

sanjay: good. we'll hold rollout and investigate what in r12 exacerbated node-3. assign to eng-runtime to triage. tagging @eng-runtime leads in follow-up.

irene: opened PR #412 to adjust probe retries and added a short-run smoke harness for canary rolling.

mia: noted. document decision in release notes: "eu canary paused due to prefix-kv timeouts; rollouts resumed after pin and probe tuning."

jordan: thanks all. follow-ups: eng-runtime triage + ops infra check (node-3 memory/GC). if nothing found in 24h we can try a limited canary with probe tweaks. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Action summary: canary_fraction=0 (eu), pin=2026.03.11.r11 (eu), PR=412 (probe retry tweak), incident=false (ops handled).
